name: wide_diverse_v1
sampling_objective: Equal contribution per conservative training cohort; exact class-stratification importance correction within each cohort. Sampling is with replacement. No fabricated labels or imagery augmentation.
selection: Highest exact average precision on original validation queries; patience-based stopping. Freeze matched-MODIS-false-positive policy on validation before benchmark prediction.
scope: Research VIIRS-reference detection. Original validation and 2024 benchmark were previously examined. Extra training windows are selected using training-only reference locations and independent source checks. Additional queries are not independent wildfire incidents.
